Task 1 · 平面图 学院咖啡厅改造
0% · 0 / 2 完成

根据两张平面图作答。

The plans show a college café before its redesign and at present.

写 55–75 个英文词，描述两间原 staff dining rooms 的去向，并对比厨房、厕所和中央座位区。

作答 1
暂时不会

修改这段文字中所有与图不符或缺少依据的内容，保留能由图支持的变化：The kitchen was moved to the south, while all the indoor tables were removed. A coffee bar replaced the kitchen. The old serving area now offers only hot meals, and the café provides outdoor seating beside a barbecue.

作答 2
暂时不会
答案
再练一次

选材来源 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · Test 2 · Task 1

A coffee bar replaced the kitchen. The old serving area now offers only hot meals, and the café provides outdoor seating beside a barbecue.作答 2暂时不会答案1. 示例：The two former staff dining rooms have been converted into two separate food and drink outlets: takeaway food occupies the room on the left, while a coffee bar has replaced the room on the right. In contrast, the kitchen and toilets remain in their original locations, and the central area is still used for tables and chairs.2. 示例：The kitchen remains in place, and the central indoor seating area has been retained. A coffee bar has replaced the right-hand staff dining room. The former serving area is now labelled 'Hot meals', while outdoor seating and a barbecue have been added.再练一次写两句 overview：一句概括食品供应设施的变化，一句对比保留的室内功能与新增的室外空间。不要猜测客流、营业时间或容纳人数。作答暂时不会答案The café now has a wider range of dedicated food and drink outlets. The kitchen, toilets and central indoor seating area have been retained, while outdoor seating and a barbecue have been added.选材来源 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · Test 2 · Task 1
